scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

apps.access_detail: Free Developer Edition; API Enabled permission required. Production edition entitlement is separate.
apps.surface: REST; broad CRM objects and queries
apps.note: Prototype in a developer org; confirm customer API entitlement before rollout.

mcp.scope: Hosted Salesforce resource servers; org/client setup required

apps.workflow: Read CRM accounts in a developer org
apps.next_action: Create a Salesforce developer org, authorize a scoped client, and query a small Account sample before requesting access to customer production data.
apps.success_criterion: Return Account identifiers and selected fields; prove the client cannot access unrelated objects.
apps.alternative_action: Confirm production API entitlement separately from developer-org access.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Free developer/test account; private app token for owned accounts; public apps use OAuth.
apps.note: Legacy API-key guidance is stale; use private app tokens or OAuth.
apps.next_action: Use a HubSpot developer test account and a private-app token to read a seeded contact; design OAuth separately for customer installations.
apps.success_criterion: Return the seeded contact and its chosen properties; demonstrate a denied ungranted scope.
apps.alternative_action: For a multi-customer product, validate OAuth installation and app-review requirements instead of sharing private tokens.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: API token included with every plan; developer sandbox path documented.
apps.surface: REST; broad deals, people, activities and webhooks
apps.note: Use OAuth for distributed apps; a personal token inherits the user's access.
apps.workflow: List deals in a trial account
apps.next_action: Seed two Pipedrive deals in a trial, list them with a personal token, then document the OAuth scopes required for a distributed app.
apps.success_criterion: Retrieve the seeded deals and correctly follow pagination without exposing other users' tokens.
apps.alternative_action: Compare the official MCP deal tools with the required custom fields before building a REST wrapper.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: API access available on all plans; an active workspace is required.
apps.surface: REST; records, lists, tasks and notes
apps.note: Official MCP offers a faster start; validate whether its tools cover the intended workflow.
apps.next_action: Connect Attio's official MCP to a test workspace and check whether company lookup and required attributes are exposed.
apps.success_criterion: Find one seeded company and return the requested attributes with its record ID.
apps.alternative_action: Use the REST records API when the MCP omits a needed custom attribute; verify field-level permissions.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Self-hosting path; hosted plan is a separate purchase decision.
apps.surface: REST + GraphQL; generated CRM object APIs
apps.note: Self-hosted credentials require an installed workspace; do not infer OAuth from website navigation.
apps.next_action: Run a local Twenty workspace, create a test object, and compare its generated REST and GraphQL representations.
apps.success_criterion: Read the same seeded object through the selected interface and document its schema.
apps.alternative_action: Wrap the local API; do not introduce browser-session dependencies where a generated API exists.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: API documented for both free and paid Podio accounts; register a client.
apps.surface: REST; items, apps, workspaces and tasks
apps.note: Prefer authorization code or app auth; avoid collecting users' passwords.
apps.workflow: Read an item in a test workspace
apps.next_action: Create a Podio app with a test item and use app authentication or OAuth to retrieve its fields.
apps.success_criterion: Return the test item with stable field identifiers and the intended workspace scope.
apps.alternative_action: Validate the app-auth path for a single app before selecting broader user OAuth.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Developer console registration and CRM organization required; edition limits apply; free eligibility not settled here.
apps.surface: REST; CRM modules, records and automation
apps.note: Tokens are organization, environment and region specific; verify edition credits before launch.
apps.workflow: Read a CRM module in the correct region
apps.next_action: Confirm the Zoho CRM edition's API allowance, then authorize the correct regional organization and read a test module record.
apps.success_criterion: Record the region, organization, allowed API credits and one successful scoped read.
apps.alternative_action: If entitlement is unclear, ask support about the exact edition and module; a web-session capture is not proof of API entitlement.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.description: Sales CRM with calling and outreach
apps.access_detail: Generate keys in account settings or create an OAuth app; trial entitlement not independently established.
apps.surface: REST; leads, contacts and sales activity
apps.note: API key is the Basic username with an empty password; OAuth is preferred for public apps.

mcp.scope: Read, safe-write and destructive-write scope groups

apps.workflow: Retrieve a lead and its contacts
apps.next_action: Confirm whether Close trial accounts include the API, then use a test key to retrieve a lead with associated contacts.
apps.success_criterion: Record the trial entitlement source and retrieve the seeded lead using the documented Basic-key format.
apps.alternative_action: For an existing authorized tenant, inspect lead-detail reads to map missing UI fields; prefer the documented API when it covers them.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.description: Relationship CRM for Google Workspace teams
apps.access_detail: API available on trial, Professional and Business plans.
apps.surface: REST; CRM people, companies, opportunities and activity
apps.note: Keys require both token and user email; partner OAuth is a separate path.
apps.workflow: Read an opportunity in a trial
apps.next_action: Create a Copper trial opportunity and read it using the required API token and user-email context.
apps.success_criterion: Return the opportunity ID and stage, and document which user's permissions apply.
apps.alternative_action: Request partner OAuth details only when customer distribution is required; a trial key is a separate development route.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.description: Deal and relationship management for financial firms
apps.access_detail: Customer tenant and API-enabled user group; admin or customer-success help if missing.
apps.surface: REST; data, schema, users, publications and backups
apps.note: API key is exchanged through client-credentials OAuth; it is not simply a static bearer key.
apps.next_action: Ask an authorized DealCloud administrator for a test instance and the client-credentials setup, then read one entity schema.
apps.success_criterion: Obtain a test token and return schema metadata for the approved entity.
apps.alternative_action: If direct test access is unavailable, request a sanitized schema export and documented token flow from the vendor.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
